payables_total.basis: payable rows read from the registry contract by the scan at scanned_at (491 rows read; ids known to this server, both sellers); counts rows whose status is Unpaid or Paid (the rows /api/invoices lists)

paid_total.basis: payable rows read from the registry contract by the scan at scanned_at (491 rows read; ids known to this server, both sellers); counts rows whose status is Paid

voided_total.basis: payable rows read from the registry contract by the scan at scanned_at (491 rows read; ids known to this server, both sellers); counts rows whose status is Voided

reserved_total.basis: payable rows read from the registry contract by the scan at scanned_at (491 rows read; ids known to this server, both sellers); counts rows whose status is Reserved

refused_on_chain_since_deploy.basis: distinct transaction hashes the chain rejected: 15 from recorded evidence files + 15 logged live by this server. Not a chain counter (the chain has none); every hash is listed at /api/stats/refusals and re-checkable on chain.

last_verifier_run_at.basis: time of the last verifier run this API performed (before_pay or after_pay); a server timestamp, not chain state

by_kind.rule: demo = curated demo invoices (seller 1 ids 10, 11; seller 2 ids 1, 2), the open payables seeded for judges (seller 1 ids 1095-1098, seller 2 ids 5002-5005) and every payable registered through the app (recorded in the server list counters.demoIds); matrix = seller 1 ids 1-5 (contract-matrix tests); lab = every other row (automated test runs, registered with x-payonce-run: test or before provenance was recorded). Never depends on status.
